name: Sexual Dysfunction, Paraphilias and Gender Dysphoria

reference.pathophysiology: Vascular, neurogenic, endocrine and serotonergic drug influences interrupt sexual response phases, while gender identity development and atypical arousal pattern conditioning follow distinct developmental pathways requiring non conflated care.
